sources.prompt: Production transparent game sprite atlas, exactly 4 small display objects for a cozy desktop yard, strict TWO columns by TWO rows, equal cells, landscape 1536x1024. Style matches the two attached reference images exactly: soft sculpted painted miniature detail, rich restrained warm colours, gentle material shading, clean silhouettes. All four are EMPTY containers, nothing living inside, because the app draws the contents separately. (1) top-left SMALL ROUND GLASS FISHBOWL: a clear round goldfish bowl with a wide open rim, two-thirds filled with clear pale aqua water, a few smooth pebbles and one short green water plant at the bottom, sitting on a small round wooden coaster; NO fish. (2) top-right GLASS BUG JAR: an upright clear glass jar with a cork stopper tied with twine, one small dry twig with two leaves leaning inside, the glass mostly empty and clear; NO insect, NO glow. (3) bottom-left WOODEN SPECIMEN CASE: an upright warm wooden box standing on its back edge, seen straight from the front, with a glass front and FIVE EMPTY square compartments lined in soft cream felt, three on the top row and two on the bottom row, evenly spaced; NOTHING inside the compartments. (4) bottom-right PRESSED FLOWER FRAME: an upright small wooden picture frame on a little wooden easel stand, seen straight from the front, with a plain cream textured paper mount behind glass; the paper is EMPTY. Each object fully inside the central 80% of its cell, bottom baseline aligned, similar heights. Glass reads as clear with soft highlights, never frosted. ACTUAL fully transparent RGBA background, no floor, no shadow, no haze, no text, labels or gridlines. IMPORTANT: the background must be truly transparent alpha everywhere outside each object.
sources.processing: Alpha below 50 cleared to 0,0,0,0 in the runtime atlas; all other samples unchanged.
